title: Microsoft presents: Large scale development with AL-Go

chapters.title: The broken window theory in software
Broken windows at scale and telemetry data
Custom jobs and AL-Go workflow extensions
AL-Go telemetry dashboard in Azure Data Explorer
GitHub Copilot CLI and custom dashboards

features.name: AL-Go custom jobs
features.description: AL-Go now offers a way to extend workflows with custom jobs that can be added to YAML files without being overwritten during system updates. Users can add custom job definitions to their workflow files to extend AL-Go's base behavior.
caveats: Users might depend on jobs that no longer exist in future versions
Users might pick names for custom jobs that AL-Go picks in the future

features.name: AL-Go custom templates
features.description: A new capability to manage custom AL-Go templates across multiple repositories from a central repository. Organizations can point multiple end repositories to a custom template repository and propagate common jobs, scripts, and settings across all repositories using a single update operation.
caveats: Custom template repositories should typically not have AL-Go code in them

features.name: AL-Go organizational settings
features.description: AL-Go supports managing settings at multiple levels including user, project, repository, and organizational levels. Moving settings to organizational level helps standardize configuration across repositories.
caveats: Many configurable settings can make it hard to manage consistency

features.name: Template file propagation
features.description: Automatic propagation of settings from custom templates to end repositories when running update ecosystem files, preventing duplicate management across multiple repositories.

features.name: AL-Go telemetry module
features.description: AL-Go ships with telemetry module that emits data to Application Insights, tracking workflow outcomes, individual action durations, error messages, and test results.
features.status_evidence_quote: AL Go ships with a telemetry module as well, so you can hook into that and and emit telemetry to application insights
caveats: Requires partner telemetry connection string configuration

features.name: Partner telemetry connection string setting
features.description: AL-Go configuration setting for connecting to Application Insights, which can be set in templates and propagated to custom template repositories.

features.name: AL-Go Azure Data Explorer dashboard
features.description: Starter dashboard template using AL-Go telemetry data, providing views into workflow status, pipeline performance, error messages, runner types, and AL-Go version maintenance across multiple repositories.
caveats: Requires manual import of JSON configuration file

features.name: GitHub Copilot CLI desktop app
features.description: Desktop application that organizes GitHub Copilot CLI sessions and repositories, providing centralized management and ability to build custom UIs for AL-Go operations and dashboards.
caveats: Still runs GitHub Copilot CLI behind the scenes

features.name: Custom Copilot canvas UIs
features.description: Ability to create custom user interfaces within GitHub Copilot app using prompts, enabling personal AL-Go control centers and automated task management for PR reviews and pipeline failures.

features.name: Agent-assisted CI/CD investigation
features.description: Ability to delegate CI/CD failure investigation to an agent within Copilot app, starting a new session to interactively investigate why workflows are failing.

features.name: Versioning strategy configuration via GitHub organization variables
features.description: AL-Go supports assigning versioning strategy through GitHub organization variables as an alternative to template configuration, allowing global configuration across repositories.
caveats: Variable name not recalled during session
Templates are preferred for version control

features.name: AppSource and beer tenant extension templates
features.description: AL-Go provides separate templates for AppSource extensions and beer tenant extensions, with minor functional differences between them and approximately 95% shared content.
